title: potentilla pensylvanica var. longepilosa
intro: Potentilla pensylvanica var. longepilosa, commonly known as Pennsylvania cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a sought-after remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla pensylvanica var. longepilosa include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
